mapper.insert: insert into sys_work_rating (work_id, user_id, score, created_at, updated_at) values (#{workId}, #{userId}, #{score}, now(), now()) on duplicate key update score = values(score), updated_at = now()
mapper.update: update sys_work w set rating = coalesce((select round(avg(r.score), 1) from sys_work_rating r where r.work_id = w.work_id), 0) where w.work_id = #{workId}
